title: Renderer interface + retrofit Pretext onto it

comments.author: home
comments.text:
GOAL: prove the Renderer contract by retrofitting the EXISTING Pretext path onto it. No Markus code in this task.

WHY FIRST: PR #57's lib/publisher.ts is a metadata-only record with no operations - nothing would fail to compile if the contract were wrong. All three of its fields are pure functions of id (requiresPretext === (id==='pretext')), and it bakes one implementation's name into the generic interface. The only real test of an interface is whether the existing implementation fits through it.

NOMENCLATURE (decided, use exactly): Renderer x Layout.
- Renderer = the swappable system that turns content into a site: 'pretext' | 'markus'
- Layout = the look WITHIN Pretext: 'newsprint' | 'blog' | 'magazine'
- 'publication' stays reserved for the title/property (P.apyr.us, Threat Intelligence, Pilobil.us)
- Do NOT use: publisher, publication type, front end, press, site type.
- Note: today's enum value is 'newspaper'; rename to 'newsprint' to match how the team actually talks about it.

SCOPE:
1. DELETE lib/publisher.ts (from PR #57). Replace with lib/renderer.ts defining a Renderer interface with REAL operations. Derive the operation set from what components/presentation-shell.tsx and app routes actually need - read them first, do not guess. Expect something like: renderEdition, renderArticle, stylesheets, and a capability/validation hook.
2. Retrofit the existing Pretext path to implement that interface under renderers/pretext/. Behavior must be byte-identical - this is a pure refactor.
3. NO boolean fields named after an implementation (requiresPretext is banned). If a renderer needs to declare a capability, name the capability, not the implementation.
4. Decouple the hardcoded publications/threat_intelligence/* imports in components/presentation-shell.tsx (BlogPageBackground) and components/article-page.tsx (PictogramFigure) so a non-TI publication loads cleanly.

VERIFY: npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run build, and the BDD suite must pass. Report exact commands and output. Pre-existing failure to expect: components/amplify-client-provider.tsx 'Cannot find module ../amplify_outputs.json' (gitignored generated file) - that one is not yours.

Branch feature/renderer-architecture is already checked out. Commit there.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
REVIEW: ACCEPTED. Committed as f9b073f on feature/renderer-architecture.

WHAT LANDED: lib/publisher.ts DELETED. lib/renderer.ts defines Renderer with real operations - renderEdition, renderArticle, renderItem, stylesheets(), supportsLayout(). Pretext moved under renderers/pretext/. Five call sites now go THROUGH the interface (JSX member-expression tags) rather than importing components directly, so the contract is actually exercised, not merely type-compatible.

THE CONTRACT TEST PASSED. That was the point of doing this first: the existing implementation fits through the interface without contortion. supportsLayout is backed by a real PRETEXT_LAYOUTS value that lib/site-brand.ts also consumes - it is NOT a pure function of id, which is exactly what was wrong with PR #57's requiresPretext. No implementation-named booleans survive.

VERIFIED BY ME INDEPENDENTLY (not taken on report):
- npm run lint: clean.
- npm run typecheck: CLEAN, zero errors.
- 'newspaper' as an enum value: fully gone. The 3 remaining occurrences are a presentation-footer CSS variant and a favicon icon name - correctly left alone.
- npm run build: FAILS at 'Collecting page data' (TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object in listPublishedEditions/listArticleSlugs). I checked out origin/develop and got the IDENTICAL failure, so it is PRE-EXISTING and environmental - the build fetches live AppSync data and no backend is reachable. NOT caused by this change.
- BDD: 117 scenarios, 39 failed, 27 undefined, 49 skipped, 2 passed. A develop baseline run is in flight. Two known pre-existing causes: features/operator-cli.feature has zero cucumber-js step definitions (it targets behave), and console scenarios have no seeded GraphQL data. Tracked as PPY-fd8468; a real backend (PPY-6b4094) may resolve the second outright.

NOTE ON TYPECHECK: it passes partly because a synthetic amplify_outputs.json now exists locally (gitignored, uncommitted, generated during the work). The module-not-found error PR #57 called pre-existing is masked by that file, not fixed by code. Do not read 'typecheck clean' as evidence the Amplify wiring is healthy.

TWO CONCERNS THE AGENT RAISED, BOTH SPLIT OUT RATHER THAN WAVED THROUGH:
- PPY-61dc8f: persisted reader setting 'newspaper' now silently falls back to default after the rename. Real behavioral edge.
- PPY-f25738: lib/site-brand.ts importing from renderers/pretext/layouts.ts inverts the layering. No cycle, but worth a deliberate call once PPY-eca592 lands.

PROCESS NOTE, MY FAULT NOT THE AGENT'S: I committed the working tree and checked out origin/develop for a baseline comparison WHILE this agent was still live. The agent correctly flagged the unexplained commit and detached HEAD as suspicious. No damage - content verified correct - but I created that race and should not have.

UNBLOCKS: PPY-a10206, PPY-88f77b, PPY-eca592.
